assumptions: Explicitly assisted, post-hoc demonstration rescue. This does not measure autonomous scientific recovery.
Canonical reference channel interpretation informs directions only, including anonymous v02=EGP, v03=Uii, v04=E, v05=Gt. No reference numerical coefficients or new inner laws are supplied.
Both arms start from this same original historical checkpoint, not the prior all-positive repair or a later pruned endpoint.
Initial conditions remain training-fitted and can be signed. Positive outer gains do not certify global state positivity or total intervention monotonicity.
A changed domain or outer operator resets that gain to the ordinary role-based start; no absolute value of a wrong-signed fit is used. Other saved parameters are retained.

Parameters, seed retention and pruning ranking use training; pruning acceptance uses validation. Existing intervention observations motivated this exploratory study but are not optimization or selection inputs.

edits.rationale: Meal appearance is hypothesized to be an additive glucose source through the existing pathway.
Endogenous glucose production is treated as a source in the plasma balance.
Insulin-independent glucose utilization is treated as removal from the plasma balance.
Renal glucose excretion is treated as removal from the plasma balance.
Reference-informed canonical compartment interpretation: tissue-to-plasma return is a positive contribution. This is an assisted sign hypothesis, not entailed by the public tissue-mass label.
Plasma self-clearance and outward exchange are represented as dissipative self-feedback, with a nonnegative fitted magnitude.
